entries.sense_en: everything a person owns, especially what is left to others after death

synonyms.nuance: General word for things owned, often land or buildings; not tied to death or inheritance.
Focuses on what you receive from someone who died, seen from the heir's side.
synonyms.example: She spent her inheritance on a house.

synonyms.nuance: Business or legal word for things of value, including money and shares.

entries.tip_ko: 'estate'는 '넓은 땅, 영지'라는 뜻도 있어 뒤에 나오는 'vast estates'는 '광대한 영지'로 읽는다.

entries.sense_en: the dividing of something into shares among several people

synonyms.nuance: Plain, everyday word for splitting anything into parts.
Stresses handing out shares to many people, not the act of cutting up.
Informal; often used for money or shares between a few people.

entries.tip_ko: 현대에는 주로 '칸막이'나 '국가 분할'의 뜻으로 쓰인다.

entries.sense_en: a person paid to write legal papers such as contracts and wills

synonyms.nuance: Office worker who keeps records; a general, modern word.
Someone who copied texts by hand, especially before printing.
Official who witnesses and certifies legal documents.

entries.sense_en: property inherited from one's father

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for anything received from someone who died, from any relative.
Money left in a will, or figuratively something handed down, like ideas.
Usually culture, traditions, or buildings passed down in a community, not private money.

entries.tip_ko: 강세는 첫 음절 PAT-에 온다: 패트러모우니.

entries.sense_en: very sad, with nothing to cheer him up

synonyms.nuance: Common everyday word for very unhappy; also used of bad weather or places.
Formal; so sad that no one can comfort you.
About physical or social unease, not deep sadness.

entries.tip_ko: 'uncomfortable(불편한)'과 다르다. 여기서는 '마음을 달랠 길 없는'이라는 뜻.

entries.sense_en: a short tube of fur that you put your hands into to keep them warm

synonyms.nuance: Worn on each hand separately, with one part for the thumb.
Has separate fingers; the usual modern choice.
Same idea, but two warm pads that cover the ears.

entries.sense_en: pretended; acted in a way that suggested something untrue

synonyms.nuance: Most common modern word; neutral, used for games or deception.
Everyday phrase; stresses outward behavior.
synonyms.example: She acted as if nothing had happened.

synonyms.nuance: Formal; pretending to have a feeling or condition.

entries.tip_ko: 'make as if to + 동사'는 '~하려는 시늉을 하다'라는 뜻으로 지금도 문어에서 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: to make yourself suffer or feel great distress

synonyms.nuance: Milder; worry or bother, often small problems.
Stronger; long, severe mental or physical pain, often deliberate.
Causes anxiety and sorrow; common in formal and news English.

entries.tip_ko: 현대 영어에서는 보통 질병·재난이 사람을 '괴롭히다'(be afflicted with a disease)로 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: to run quickly and lightly, like a small animal

synonyms.nuance: Short quick steps, often nervously or in a hurry.
One sudden fast run to a place; not tied to small animals.
Moving quickly but clumsily, often using hands, over rough ground.

entries.sense_en: wild bushes with sharp thorns, such as blackberry bushes

synonyms.nuance: The sharp point itself, or any thorny plant.
Similar thorny wild plant, often wild rose; a little literary.
Any low bushes and plants in a forest, not necessarily thorny.

entries.sense_en: to rely on or put hope in something

synonyms.nuance: Everyday phrase: trust that something will happen or someone will help.
Neutral; depend on something because you need it.
Stresses hoping for one uncertain thing to succeed.
synonyms.example: They pinned their hopes on the new player.

entries.tip_ko: 현대의 'build on'은 주로 '~을 토대로 발전시키다'라는 뜻이다.

entries.sense_en: clever in a tricky, secret way

synonyms.nuance: Hides intentions; often slightly negative or playful.
Good at tricking people to get what you want; negative.
Neutral or positive; simply intelligent.

entries.tip_ko: 한국어 '커닝(시험 부정행위)'은 영어로 cheating이다.

entries.sense_en: in a grand, stylish, confident way

synonyms.nuance: Simply with courage; no idea of style or fine manners.
Stylish and attractive, usually of a man's looks or clothes.
Polite and protective, especially a man toward women.

entries.sense_en: an area of ground full of rabbit holes where many rabbits live
entries.sense_ko: 토끼 굴이 많은 곳, 토끼 사육장

synonyms.nuance: A single hole or tunnel an animal digs to live in.
Home of a wild animal like a fox or lion; not always underground.
Figuratively, a confusing network; a warren is also used this way.

entries.sense_en: to search through something by moving things around carelessly

synonyms.nuance: Neutral; any careful or careless looking for something.
Violent and destructive, often by thieves.
Informal; digging through things like an animal with its nose.

entries.sense_en: tricks and lies used to fool others

synonyms.nuance: The act of deceiving; more neutral, also used for illusions.
Clever tricks to cheat someone; slightly lighter tone.
Legal or financial cheating to get money.

entries.sense_en: acting too quickly without thinking about the danger

synonyms.nuance: Ignores danger again and again; stronger and more habitual.
Done too fast; about a decision, less about danger.
Acting on sudden feelings; a personality trait.

entries.tip_ko: 명사 rash는 '발진, 두드러기'라는 전혀 다른 뜻이다.

entries.sense_en: a bow made to show deep respect

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for bending the body or head to greet or honor.
Women's bow, bending the knees.
The feeling, not the physical movement.

entries.tip_ko: 현대에는 주로 '깊은 존경, 경외심'(feel reverence for)이라는 감정을 뜻한다.

entries.sense_en: a pair of game birds or animals

synonyms.nuance: General word for two of anything.
Two people together, or informally 'about two'.
Two people working or performing together.

entries.sense_en: to go outside for a walk or ride to enjoy fresh air

synonyms.nuance: Everyday modern phrase for the same idea.
synonyms.example: Let's go out and get some fresh air.

synonyms.nuance: Specifically a slow, relaxed walk.
Riding in a car for pleasure, like the King's coach ride.
synonyms.example: We went for a drive along the coast.

entries.modern: go out for some fresh air

entries.sense_en: the reason for something (two words with the same meaning, used for emphasis)

synonyms.nuance: Plain modern equivalent.
All the details of a situation, not only the reason.
synonyms.example: the ins and outs of the plan

synonyms.nuance: Used in negatives: no logic at all.

entries.tip_ko: wherefore는 'where'가 아니라 'why'라는 뜻이다(Romeo, wherefore art thou Romeo?).

entries.sense_en: a dishonest or criminal man

synonyms.nuance: Specifically someone who steals.
Old-fashioned; a man who treats others very badly.
Now mostly playful, e.g. a naughty child.

entries.sense_en: treated with great warmth and friendly attention

synonyms.nuance: Modern informal: give someone a lot of attention and care.
Touching lovingly, sometimes sexual; only physical.
Moving a hand gently over something, physical only.

entries.modern: made a great fuss of him
entries.tip_ko: 현대에서는 '부드럽게 쓰다듬다'라는 신체적 의미가 거의 전부다.

entries.sense_en: a person's appearance and manner

synonyms.nuance: How you stand and move; suggests dignity.
Outward behavior and mood, especially calm or serious.
Just how someone looks, without manner.

entries.tip_ko: 발음은 mean과 같다: /min/.

entries.sense_en: made something look better by contrast or decoration

synonyms.nuance: Also means display well, but more often boasting.
synonyms.example: The dress shows off her figure.

synonyms.nuance: Formal; improve the quality or look of something.
Make a hidden quality more noticeable.
synonyms.example: That color brings out your eyes.

entries.tip_ko: set off는 '출발하다', '(경보를) 울리다'라는 뜻이 더 흔하니 문맥으로 구별한다.

entries.sense_en: a feeling of liking or attraction toward someone

synonyms.nuance: Warm liking, often long-lasting and gentle.
Being drawn to someone, especially romantically.
A habit of behavior, not a feeling for a person.

entries.modern: took a secret liking to him

entries.sense_en: so strongly that you almost go mad

synonyms.nuance: Common with love: 'madly in love'.
Informal idiom for falling completely in love.
Suggests strong need or unhappiness.

entries.tip_ko: 보통 distraction은 '주의를 흩뜨리는 것'이지만 'drive someone to distraction'처럼 '미칠 지경'의 뜻도 있다.

entries.sense_en: to cut grass or grain with a blade

synonyms.nuance: General word for any cutting.
Cutting and gathering a grain crop at harvest.
Cutting a little to make neat.

entries.sense_en: to produce a crop or result

synonyms.nuance: General word for making or growing something.
Used of trees and plants carrying fruit.
Creating energy, money or ideas, not crops.

entries.tip_ko: yield는 '양보하다'(도로 표지 YIELD)라는 뜻도 있다.

entries.sense_en: a person who cuts and gathers grain at harvest time

synonyms.nuance: Cuts grass or hay; today usually a machine.
Modern word, often a big farm machine.
Any hired worker on a farm.

entries.tip_ko: 'the Grim Reaper'는 낫을 든 '죽음의 신'이다.

entries.sense_en: about that thing just mentioned
entries.sense_ko: 그 일에 대해, 그 점에 관해

synonyms.nuance: Plain modern equivalent.
Another sense of thereupon: right after that.
As a result; formal linking word.

entries.sense_en: large, grand, and impressive

synonyms.nuance: Big and splendid; common and general.
So big it makes you feel small or impressed.
Beautiful and powerful, often of nature.

entries.tip_ko: 'a stately home'은 영국의 대저택을 가리키는 표현이다.

entries.sense_en: politely, with basic good manners

synonyms.nuance: Common everyday word; warmer than civilly.
Formal; polite and considerate.
Warm and friendly, not just correct.

entries.tip_ko: civil은 '겨우 무례하지 않은 정도'의 최소한의 예의를 뜻할 때가 많다.

entries.sense_en: to want to or intend to do something

synonyms.nuance: Informal; a passing wish.
Clear plan or purpose, more formal.
Leaning toward doing something, often mild.

entries.tip_ko: 'have half a mind to'는 '~할까 말까 하다'라는 현대 표현이다.

entries.sense_en: quickly and in a confident, energetic way

synonyms.nuance: Just fast; no sense of energy or confidence.
Short and rude in speech.
Quick and sharp, often of movement or walking.

entries.sense_en: the channel along the edge of a roof that carries rainwater away

synonyms.nuance: The vertical pipe running down the wall from the gutter.
A long channel dug in the ground beside a road or field.
synonyms.example: The car went into a ditch.

synonyms.nuance: Opening or pipe that takes water away, usually underground.

entries.tip_ko: 길가의 도랑도 gutter라서 'in the gutter'는 '밑바닥 인생'을 뜻하기도 한다.

entries.sense_en: admitted that something was true

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for agreeing something (often bad) is true.
Admit something shameful or a crime.
Modern phrasal verb: admit a fault.
synonyms.example: Nobody owned up to breaking it.

entries.tip_ko: 여기서 own은 '소유하다'가 아니라 '인정하다'(= admit)이다.

entries.sense_en: very soon, in a moment

synonyms.nuance: Common neutral word for a short time from now.
Slightly formal; used in announcements.
Means 'now', the other sense of presently in American English.

entries.tip_ko: 미국 영어에서는 presently가 '현재'(currently)의 뜻으로도 쓰여 헷갈리기 쉽다.

entries.sense_en: to attack suddenly

synonyms.nuance: Jump suddenly to catch, like a cat on a mouse.
synonyms.example: The cat pounced on the toy.

synonyms.nuance: General word for using violence against someone.
Take hold of suddenly and firmly.

entries.sense_en: large, with plenty of room

synonyms.nuance: Informal; enough space inside, often of cars or clothes.
Extremely large, often land or sea.
Large from side to side only.

entries.sense_en: a light meal laid out for guests

synonyms.nuance: Food set out for guests to serve themselves.
A large formal feast, heavier than a collation.
Light food and drinks at an event.

entries.tip_ko: 현대에는 주로 '(자료의) 수집·대조'라는 뜻으로 쓰인다.

entries.sense_en: to give an honor, title, or right to someone

synonyms.nuance: Formal, a bit old; give a gift or honor generously.
Give officially, often permission or money.
Give a prize for achievement.

entries.tip_ko: confer with는 '상의하다'라는 다른 뜻이다.

entries.sense_en: immediately, without delay

synonyms.nuance: Everyday neutral word.
Common, a little stronger or more urgent.
Informal, mostly British.

entries.sense_en: something done for fun or amusement

synonyms.nuance: General enjoyment from something funny or pleasant.
A regular hobby you enjoy in free time.
Takes attention away, often unwanted.

entries.tip_ko: 영국 도로 표지 'Diversion'은 '우회로'라는 뜻이다.
